print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics: Paginated APIs require looping]: loop through all pages of album library</playbook_cite>')

album_song_ids = set()
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album_library_page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    for alb in res:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids') or []:
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

print('total_album_song_ids', len(album_song_ids))

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics: Paginated APIs require looping]: loop through all pages of playlist library</playbook_cite>')

playlist_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist_library_page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    for pl in res:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids') or []:
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlist_song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids))

song_library_song_ids = set(song_info_by_id.keys())

print('<uncertainty>Not sure how file_system paths treat ~/backups; will use given path as parameter</uncertainty>')

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Build deterministic rows
rows = []
for sid, (title, artists) in song_info_by_id.items():
    rows.append((sid, title, artists))
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1].lower(), x[0]))

header = 'Title,Artists'
lines = [header]
for sid, title, artists in rows:
    lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists)}")

csv_content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines_total_including_header', len(lines))
print('unique_song_count', len(rows))
print('first_data_line', lines[1] if len(lines)>1 else None)
print('last_data_line', lines[-1] if len(lines)>1 else None)

# Ensure directory exists
# Login token for file_system is expected as file_token in globals
print('file_token_present', 'file_token' in globals() and bool(file_token))

dir_path = '~/backups'
print('checking_directory_exists', dir_path)
dir_exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=file_token)['exists']
print('dir_exists', dir_exists)
if not dir_exists:
    res_dir = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=file_token)
    print('create_directory_res', res_dir)

file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'
file_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path, access_token=file_token)['exists']
print('file_exists_before', file_exists)

if file_exists:
    res_upd = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=file_path, content=csv_content, access_token=file_token)
    print('update_file_res', res_upd)
else:
    res_create = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, content=csv_content, access_token=file_token)
    print('create_file_res', res_create)

# Verify final state
file_exists_after = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path, access_token=file_token)['exists']
print('file_exists_after', file_exists_after)
# Show small prefix
shown = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_token)
print('shown_keys', list(shown.keys()))
content_shown = shown.get('content','')
print('shown_content_length', len(content_shown))
print('shown_prefix', content_shown[:200].replace('\n','\\n'))
print('shown_last_100', content_shown[-100:].replace('\n','\\n'))

# Verify row count by counting newlines
num_lines = content_shown.strip('\n').count('\n')+1 if content_shown.strip('\n') else 0
print('verified_line_count', num_lines)
